name: @wenathlan/devthink
description: DevThink is the merged AI development workbench: the provider-owned gateway engine, the DevThink browser extension (the agent surface), the Antigravity engine and the workbench CLI — one product, one binary, one metadata.

scripts.check: bun run check:secrets && bun run test
scripts.records:sync: node agentcert.ts sync && node costcert.ts sync && node doccheck.ts sync && node matrixverify.ts sync && node pentest.ts sync && node poolaudit.ts sync && node ../foundry/readiness.ts sync && node recipes.ts sync && node soak.ts sync && node sweep.ts sync && node telemetryfree.ts sync && node wcag.ts sync
scripts.release: bun run check && bun run build
scripts.validate: pnpm check:metadata && pnpm validate:runtime && pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm validate:security && pnpm validate:agents && pnpm validate:workflow && pnpm validate:apifreeze && pnpm validate:docs && pnpm validate:candidate && node recipes.ts && pnpm test && node build/cli.js manifest && node build/cli.js help && node packageextension.ts
scripts.validate:candidate: node sweep.ts && node poolaudit.ts && node matrixverify.ts && node telemetryfree.ts && node soak.ts && node wcag.ts
scripts.validate:security: node pentest.ts && node build/security.js cspaudit && node permdiff.ts

devthink.maestro: node.js is the orchestrator: every engine below answers to the maestro (devthink.ts) — family engines ride the published library packages, never a sibling-folder path; native engines ride the flat .ts files at the app root. The ownership law (pr16) rides the owner field: one engine, one owner, the family consumes — the manifest of record is engines.ts at the app root.

engines.name: versawaze
engines.role: the video and 3d engine of cadria, imported for player, studio and render surfaces.

engines.name: kathesis
engines.role: the audio engine of debonair, imported for sound, synthesis and music surfaces.

engines.name: saddle
engines.role: virtualization and sandboxes, imported to run isolated environments behind the os.

engines.name: getry
engines.role: the universal gateway: the engine (engine.ts), the llm family, the streaming parser, the model catalog, the provider surface, the request helpers, the auth family and the json family — the os imports every family through the published library specifiers (@wenathlan/getry/engine and siblings) and derives its thinking budgets from the owner's ladder through @wenathlan/getry/thinking.

engines.name: argan
engines.role: the dns engine, imported for names, zones and records on the os surfaces.

engines.name: vault
engines.role: the storage engine, imported for projects, accounts and safe keeping.

engines.name: cobaia
engines.role: the monetization engine, imported for plans, quotas and billing surfaces.

engines.name: graphrunner
engines.role: the hierarchical graphs and nodes runner, stages walked in deterministic waves.

engines.name: queue
engines.role: the request queue family: the bounded queue, the retry backoff, the token estimation, the conversation compaction, the resilient sse parsing and the id minting.

engines.name: mcpregistry
engines.role: the mcp server registry: configurations, states and health of the connected servers.

engines.name: calculator
engines.role: the pure calculator logic behind the calculator page.

engines.name: maestro
engines.role: the root orchestrator: the node maestro that commands every engine of this manifest.
